tasks.title: SMOKE: add __version__ = '0.0.1' to harness/smoke_target.py (prove the pipeline)
acceptance_criteria: The module docstring is preserved unchanged.
No other statement, import, or function is added.

tasks.verification_command: python -c "import ast, pathlib, py_compile; src = pathlib.Path('harness/smoke_target.py').read_text(); tree = ast.parse(src); assert ast.get_docstring(tree), 'module docstring must be preserved'; vers = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == '__version__' for t in n.targets)]; assert vers, '__version__ assignment missing from harness/smoke_target.py'; py_compile.compile('harness/smoke_target.py', doraise=True); print('SMOKE pipeline OK: __version__ defined')"

spec.objective: Canonical 'prove the pipeline' smoke. Add a single top-level __version__ = '0.0.1' assignment to harness/smoke_target.py, preserving the existing module docstring. This exercises the full dual-agent synthesis -> AST-merge -> verification -> scoped auto-commit path so a fresh clone can confirm the harness works end-to-end.
functional_requirements: Emit the WHOLE file harness/smoke_target.py (single-file submission, AST-merged by the harness).
Keep the existing module docstring byte-for-byte.
Add exactly one new top-level statement: __version__ = '0.0.1'.
spec.interfaces: Module-level __version__ string only; no functions or classes.
edge_cases: The change must differ from the committed stub (which has no __version__), else the commit is rejected as no_diff.
Do not introduce nondeterminism, imports, or any statement beyond the __version__ assignment.
non_goals: Do NOT modify any file other than harness/smoke_target.py.
Do NOT remove or reword the module docstring.
Do NOT add imports, functions, classes, or any statement other than __version__.
Do NOT use pytest or xfail-strict markers in the verification_command.
